note: Terrain levelling strips for Unity (game frame = Forest world, tile 1_1). For every heightmap sample at world (x, z): A, B = the line's ends, s = the distance along A->B from A, t = the distance across; w_across = 1 for t <= half_width, smoothstep((half_width + falloff - t) / falloff) beyond (0 past half_width + falloff); w_along = 1 for 0 <= s <= |AB|, 1 + s / ramp_start for s < 0, 1 - (s - |AB|) / ramp_end beyond B (linear, clamped 0..1); w = w_across * w_along; h = h + w * (height - h). Then the U7 pieces stand on it (u7_layout_v2.json); trees and rocks in the strips follow the ground (objects.in_strips)
